task.title: 诊断: Troubleshoot schema cache and API validation errors
task.shortdesc: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Diagnose unavailable schema cache, unknown schema channel, and Firefox policies validation failures without patching generated schema artifacts.

prereq.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Use this procedure when POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152, POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/beta-999, or user-facing validation returns 400, 404, 422, or 503; a non-object document can return 200 ok=false with Expected object with policy mappings.

context.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 BPM validation depends on maintained schema channels and local schema/cache configuration. The diagnostic records whether the issue is request shape, unknown profile, invalid Firefox policy data, or unavailable schema cache.

step.cmd: 诊断 1: Record the exact validation request and response.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Store sanitized request body hash, schema channel, HTTP status, detail, message, error, and issues. Keep the candidate policies.json outside logs if it contains customer values.

step.cmd: 诊断 2: Classify request-shape failures first.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 A non-object document or missing document.policies is operator input, not a schema-cache defect; current BPM can report this as 200 ok=false. Focused rerun: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152 with {"document":{"policies":{"DisableTelemetry":true}}}.

step.cmd: 诊断 3: Classify schema-channel and cache failures.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 A profile such as beta-999 can return 404; an unavailable registered schema can return 503. Check BPM_SCHEMA_BASE_URL, BPM_SCHEMA_CACHE_DIR, and BPM_SCHEMA_HTTP_TIMEOUT before any broader rebuild.

step.cmd: 诊断 4: Use maintained refresh and validation checks.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 Focused rerun: ./.venv/bin/pytest -q -m docs_contract documentation/tests/contract/test_api_openapi_drift.py for API documentation drift, or product schema tests when the API behavior changed. Do not hand-edit app/schemas/cache or generated Firefox skeletons.

step.cmd: 诊断 5: Stop unsafe recovery and preserve evidence.

info.p: 此流程保留 evidence，保护用户数据，并区分 operator action 与 product defect。 If the same valid request changes status across runs, preserve response bodies, source revision, cache path, and environment variables.
info.note: Do not edit generated schema artifacts or database rows as routine recovery; separate product defects from operator payload errors.

result.p: 操作员获得分类诊断，保护 user data，并知道下一个 smallest rerun。 The operator has a classified validation failure with a smallest rerun and no hidden schema mutation.

postreq.p: 修复后返回相关 Administrator/DevOps workflow，只重跑受影响的 checks。 After validation succeeds, return to validate-before-apply or import-review-export workflows.
